name: fight15-s15
title: Kick in the lobby seat dialog asks first, removes a connected player, and the player stays out of the match

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 2
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/relay-check.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/relay-ok.json 60
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/relay-ok.json 60
activate ButtonLobbyOptions
wait_ms 600
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageSeats
wait_ms 600
activate ButtonHostSeatDetails1
wait_ms 900
assert_visible HostSeatDialog 1
assert_label LabelHostSeatDlgName Joiner
video_mark seat-dialog-host
assert_enabled ButtonHostSeatDlgKick 1
assert_enabled ButtonHostSeatDlgBan 1
assert_text_fits LabelHostSeatDlgActionHint
assert_no_overlap LabelHostSeatDlgActionHint ButtonHostSeatDlgBan
activate ButtonHostSeatDlgKick
wait_ms 600
video_mark kick-confirm-host
assert_visible HostSeatDialog 1
assert_label ButtonHostSeatDlgKick Confirm kick
assert_label LabelHostSeatDlgActionHint Press Confirm kick to remove Joiner from this session
assert_text_fits LabelHostSeatDlgActionHint
assert_text_fits ButtonHostSeatDlgKick
activate ButtonHostSeatDlgKick
wait_ms 1200
assert_visible HostSeatDialog 0
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_substate Lobby 30
wait_label LabelLobbyPlayer1 Open seat
video_mark kicked-host
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/kick-refused.json 120
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/relay-check.json
video_mark seated-joiner
wait_label LabelMultiplayerLandingStatus The host removed you from this session
video_mark kicked-joiner
assert_text_fits LabelMultiplayerLandingStatus
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
wait_label LabelJoinSelected 1/2 players
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_label LabelJoinSelected The host removed you from this session
video_mark kick-refused-joiner
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/kick-refused.json
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/scene-end.json
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
